messages.content:
You are an expert synthetic chemist planning experiments to maximise reaction yield.
Each experiment chooses one option for every variable listed. You will see the results
of experiments already run. Choose the next batch to find the highest-yield conditions
in as few experiments as possible. Use chemical knowledge (ligand and base effects,
substrate reactivity, solvent effects) and the observed results. Balance exploiting
good regions with testing informative new combinations. Never repeat an experiment.
Return JSON only.

Pd-catalysed Buchwald-Hartwig amination of 4-chloroanisole with 4-methylaniline; choose the ligand, base and isoxazole additive.

Variables and options:
ligand:

picks.reason: Compare the 5-phenyl regioisomer with the best-performing 4-phenylisoxazole under the leading catalyst conditions.
Test the 3-phenylisoxazole regioisomer against the best-performing phenyl-substituted additive.
Assess whether a dibenzylamino substituent improves on the phenylisoxazole additive.
Compare the alternative regioisomer of the dibenzylamino additive under the leading conditions.
Test a fused benzisoxazole additive as a distinct aromatic isoxazole variant.
Compare the fused-ring isomer with the other benzisoxazole additive under the leading conditions.
Probe whether a methyl substituent and ester-bearing isoxazole can outperform the poorly performing A9 analogue.
Retest the dimethylisoxazole with the leading ligand and base to separate additive effects from the earlier conditions.
Evaluate a pyrrolyl-substituted isoxazole in the best observed ligand/base combination.
Test an ester-bearing isoxazole regioisomer distinct from the weak A9 additive.
Test a methyl-substituted phenylisoxazole to explore modification of the leading A2 additive.
Assess an isoxazole-3-carboxylate additive under the strongest observed conditions.
Test a difluorophenylisoxazole to examine whether an electron-poor aryl substituent benefits the reaction.
Evaluate a compact isoxazole ester additive as an alternative to the weakly performing ester variants.
Test a thiophene-substituted isoxazole to explore a heteroaryl additive distinct from the inactive A21.
Compare tBuXPhos with the leading XPhos conditions while holding the best additive and base fixed.
Test AdBrettPhos with the best observed additive and base to assess ligand-dependent improvement.
Check whether MTBD can improve the top additive combination despite its weaker result with A9.
Evaluate the tBuXPhos–MTBD pairing with the best-performing additive.
